data.title: Rashi Bhushan Joins Milton As AGM For Marketing And Omnichannel Media
data.description:
The move brings digital media planning and buying experience from DDB Mudra Group to Hamilton Housewares’ drinkware business

Rashi Bhushan has joined Hamilton Housewares, which owns the Milton brand, as Assistant General Manager– Marketing and Omnichannel Media, effective September 2026. Based in Mumbai, she will lead marketing and omnichannel media for the company’s drinkware business. Bhushan brings experience spanning digital strategy, media planning and buying, client management and campaign execution, having worked across advertising and media agencies including DDB Mudra Group, Madison World, Mindshare and Span Digital.

Experience In Digital Media

Before joining Hamilton Housewares, Bhushan served as Associate Vice President for Digital Media Planning and Buying at DDB Mudra Group from April 2021 to August 2026. Her responsibilities included digital strategy, media planning and buying, and leading media initiatives. She also held the role of Senior Partner – Integrated Strategy and Media during part of her tenure at the group.

Her work at DDB Mudra followed a career in digital marketing and media planning across multiple agencies, with experience in campaign strategy, client relations and execution across different sectors.

Roles Across Agencies

Bhushan worked as Business Director at Madison World from July 2018 to November 2020. In that role, she handled digital and client responsibilities for Tata Consumer Products, Welspun and other accounts, covering brand communication, media planning and buying, campaign ideation and client servicing.

Earlier, she worked as Director– Digital at Mindshare between May 2017 and January 2018, handling media planning and buying for clients including Castrol, Star India and Facebook. Her responsibilities included market and competition analysis, pitch presentations and digital initiatives.

From May 2015 to April 2017, Bhushan was Senior Account Director– Digital at Span Digital. She led client servicing, digital strategy and media planning across public- and private-sector accounts, with work spanning display, mobile, social media, search, performance marketing and website initiatives.

Focus On Omnichannel Media

At Hamilton Housewares, Bhushan’s role covers marketing and omnichannel media for drinkware. The appointment brings agency-side experience in digital planning and buying into a role focused on a consumer products business.

Omnichannel marketing connects brand communication and consumer engagement across digital and physical touchpoints. For consumer goods companies, the approach can bring media planning, brand visibility and purchasing journeys into closer alignment. Bhushan’s experience across digital strategy and integrated media is relevant to this remit.

Bhushan holds a postgraduate diploma in management, specialising in marketing and human resources, from the Institute of Management Studies, Ghaziabad. She completed the programme in 2010 after earning a bachelor’s degree in English and economics from Isabella Thoburn College.

data.title: Mansi M. Moves From Unilever To Lead Marketing At Epigamia
data.description:
The marketing leader moves from Unilever to focus on brand building, product innovation and business growth at the premium dairy company

Mansi M. joined Epigamia as Head of Marketing in October 2026, moving from Unilever after more than nine years with the consumer goods company. With over 14 years of experience across Britannia, Airtel and Unilever, her career spans sales and distribution, trade marketing, brand management and business leadership. At Epigamia, she will focus on strengthening the brand, driving innovation, expanding digital and e-commerce capabilities, and building the marketing team as the company pursues its ambition of becoming India’s most preferred premium value-added dairy brand.

Experience Across Functions

Before joining Epigamia, Mansi led brand and business growth for OZiva at Unilever as Senior Marketing Manager from August 2025 to October 2026. Her responsibilities included brand positioning, product development, campaign strategy, e-commerce and quick commerce growth, and pricing and profitability decisions. She also held P&L responsibility, balancing brand investment with commercial performance.

Between August 2023 and August 2025, she worked as Brand Manager for OZiva, leading a packaging and visual identity transformation, portfolio premiumisation and offline expansion. Her work included developing the route-to-market strategy, channel-specific portfolios and pricing architecture to support the brand’s expansion beyond online channels.

Building Sales Channels

Mansi joined Unilever in 2017 after working at Airtel as Product Manager and Assistant Manager for Sales and Distribution. At Unilever, she held roles in key account management and trade marketing before becoming Area Sales Manager for the pharmaceutical channel in August 2021.

In that role, she established the company’s pharmaceutical channel model, building its go-to-market structure, distributor network, organisational design and sales processes. She also led a cross-functional team of key account executives and territory leads as the model expanded nationally.

Earlier, she worked at Britannia Industries in trade marketing and sales development from 2012 to 2014, focusing on point-of-sale initiatives, distribution expansion and go-to-market planning.

Focus On Brand Growth

At Epigamia, Mansi’s remit includes developing campaigns and storytelling to strengthen brand distinctiveness, identifying opportunities for product innovation and improving the connection between consumer demand and e-commerce and digital commerce. She will also work on building a team focused on experimentation, execution and commercial outcomes.

Her stated approach to marketing emphasises combining creativity with measurable business impact, using data and experience to inform decisions while remaining open to new ideas. Her transition brings experience across established consumer brands and a wellness business to Epigamia as it seeks to expand its reach in the value-added dairy market.

The appointment marks a shift from leading the growth of a wellness brand within a large consumer goods organisation to taking on a marketing leadership role at a dedicated food brand, with brand building and business growth forming the core of her new responsibilities.
